notes.title: Using Unreal Engine version 5.5.3 to recompile and package
notes.content: Using Unreal Engine version 5.5.3 to recompile and package, the frame rate has been increased, the game package size has been reduced, and Lumen, MegaLights, and DLSS4 are supported. Updated a player character.
